prose.subject: URGENT: NEAR Payout Account Update for Invoice INV-68363
prose.body:
Hi Ines,

Hope your week is going well. As we discussed in our last sync, Stanmere Media is migrating our treasury operations to a new custodial wallet provider to improve settlement speeds and security for our NEAR network payouts.

To ensure there is no delay in processing the final deliverables for the Q3 campaign, please note that our payout account has been updated effective immediately. Kindly update your payment records and release the payment for Invoice INV-68363 (amount: 3662.86 USDC) to the following new secure address:

secure-stanmeremedia77.testnet

We have attached the updated remittance advice for your records. Given that our finance team is finalizing the month-end close today, it would be greatly appreciated if you could process this by end of day so the funds can be confirmed on-chain before our reconciliation cutoff.

Please confirm once you have received this update so our accounts receivable team can close the file. If you have any questions regarding the new wallet details or need the updated W-9, let me know and I will forward it right over.

Thanks for your quick turnaround on this, Ines. We really appreciate your partnership and flexibility in helping us transition smoothly.

Best regards,

Felix Brennan
Senior Account Manager
Stanmere Media
